CineStories Compliance & Policy

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2026 • Published by CineStories Digital Media Network

At MoviePulse (accessible from https://cinematicbites.com), the privacy and data security of our visitors are fundamental priorities. This Privacy Policy details the types of information we collect, the legal bases governing processing, our use of cookies and advertising technologies (including Google AdSense), and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA).

1. Information We Collect

MoviePulse operates primarily as a static, privacy-preserving publication. We do not require visitor account registration, and we do not maintain invasive user tracking databases.

A. Automatically Collected Technical Telemetry

Like standard web publishers, our CDN and web servers log non-personally identifiable technical telemetry when you access our pages:

  • Browser type, rendering engine, and operating system
  • Referring URLs, entry pages, and exit pages
  • Date, time, and duration of requests
  • Internet Protocol (IP) address (utilized solely for edge CDN routing, fraud detection, and coarse country/region-level language routing; IP addresses are not merged with personal records)

B. Voluntarily Submitted Information

If you communicate with our editorial desk via our interactive contact form or direct email, we receive the information you choose to provide (such as your name, email address, inquiry subject, and message content). This data is used solely to respond to your inquiry and is never shared, sold, or rented to third-party marketers.

2. Cookie Schedule & Tracking Technologies

Cookies are small text files stored on your browser to facilitate website functionality, remember preferences, and analyze readership traffic. The following table provides our complete, transparent cookie schedule:

Cookie Identifier Provider Classification Lifespan Operational Purpose
cinestories_lang CineStories Essential / Functional 1 Year Stores user-selected language preference (e.g. English or Hindi) for seamless navigation across sessions.
cinestories_lang_manual CineStories Essential / Functional 1 Year Remembers manual language override so edge geolocation does not overwrite your deliberate choice.
_ga, _ga_* Google Analytics 4 Analytics & Measurement 14 Months Aggregates anonymous visitor metrics (page views, session duration, scroll depth) to evaluate content performance.
__gads, __gpi Google AdSense Advertising & Delivery 13 Months Facilitates programmatic display ad serving, prevents repetitive ad exposure (frequency capping), and detects ad fraud.
DART Cookie Google DoubleClick Advertising & Targeting Session / 1 Year Serves contextual or interest-based ads based on visits across MoviePulse and other websites.

3. Google AdSense & DoubleClick DART Cookies

Google is an authorized third-party vendor on MoviePulse. Google uses cookies (including the DoubleClick DART cookie) to serve advertisements to visitors based on their visit to MoviePulse and other sites on the internet.

  • Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
  • Alternatively, visitors can opt out of third-party vendor cookies for interest-based advertising by visiting the Network Advertising Initiative (NAI) Opt-Out Page or the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) WebChoices Tool.
  • For visitors in jurisdictions requiring consent (such as the European Economic Area), personalized advertising cookies are deployed strictly following user consent.

4. European Union & UK User Rights (GDPR)

Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) and the UK Data Protection Act 2018, individuals residing in the EEA or UK enjoy eight fundamental statutory rights:

  1. Right of Access (Article 15 GDPR): You have the right to request copies of any personal data we hold concerning you.
  2. Right to Rectification (Article 16 GDPR): You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate or complete incomplete records.
  3. Right to Erasure / “Right to be Forgotten” (Article 17 GDPR): You have the right to request the deletion of your personal data under certain statutory conditions.
  4. Right to Restrict Processing (Article 18 GDPR): You have the right to request that we limit the processing of your personal data.
  5. Right to Data Portability (Article 20 GDPR): You have the right to request that we transfer data we have collected to another organization or directly to you in a structured, machine-readable format.
  6. Right to Object to Processing (Article 21 GDPR): You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing.
  7. Rights in Relation to Automated Decision-Making (Article 22 GDPR): You have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing or profiling. MoviePulse does not engage in automated individual decision-making.
  8. Right to Lodge a Complaint (Article 77 GDPR): You have the right to lodge a complaint with your national Data Protection Authority (DPA) if you believe our data processing infringes the GDPR.

Legal Bases for Processing: We process data under Article 6(1)(f) (Legitimate Interests) for website security, performance monitoring, and content delivery; and Article 6(1)(a) (Consent) for optional non-essential advertising cookies.

5. California Consumer Privacy Disclosures (CCPA & CPRA)

This section applies exclusively to California residents under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020 (CPRA):

  • Notice of Non-Sale of Personal Information: MoviePulse does NOT sell personal information of California consumers, nor do we sell or share personal information of consumers under 16 years of age.
  • Right to Know & Access: You may request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected over the preceding 12 months.
  • Right to Delete: You may request the deletion of your personal information collected by us, subject to statutory exemptions.
  • Right to Correct: You may request that we correct inaccurate personal information maintained about you.
  • Right to Non-Discrimination: We will never deny services, charge different prices, or provide a different quality of service because you exercised your statutory privacy rights.
  • “Shine the Light” Law: Under California Civil Code Section 1798.83, California residents may request information regarding disclosure of personal data to third parties for direct marketing. We do not make such disclosures.

6. Children’s Privacy Protection (COPPA & GDPR-K)

MoviePulse is an entertainment journalism portal designed for general audiences and is strictly not directed to children under 13 years of age (or under 16 in the European Union). We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has submitted personal details to our site, please contact us immediately, and we will delete such data from our records.

7. Data Retention & Security Architecture

Our website utilizes industry-standard HTTPS encryption (TLS 1.3) across all endpoints. Technical logs generated by CDN edge nodes are retained for a rolling maximum of 30 days for cybersecurity auditing, after which they are permanently purged. Contact inquiries are retained only for the duration required to resolve your query.

8. Privacy Contact & Exercising Your Rights

To exercise your GDPR or CCPA rights, or for inquiries regarding this policy, contact our designated privacy desk:

Data Protection Officer: CineStories Privacy & Legal Desk
Email: editorial@cinestories.online (Reference: Privacy Inquiry)
Backup Correspondence: sumits7196@gmail.com
Response Time: Within thirty (30) calendar days as required by law.
